Item res numero con-[?]stant, ut pecuniam numeratam possumus appendere, vel metiri. [?]ra ea eadem res, ut oleum, alibi appenditur, alibi ad mensuram [?]ntur. Ergo ibi pondere, hic mensura constat. page.notes: Left-hand fragments: the first letters of many lines are cut off by the scan edge or show-through from the left page; each is marked [?] where the line start is lost, and the words after it are as far as legible. Fragments of marginal notes at the far left, and a "XIV." above, belong to the neighbouring page and are not transcribed. Long s has been normalised to s (e.g. fed, fi, conftat, poffunt, obf), but "fiat" and "fingitur" are kept with f because the crossbar cannot be confirmed at this resolution. The printed "|" before "Intellige" is kept as printed. Paragraph division is uncertain: the page appears to be one continuous paragraph. The "vii" at foot right is not a catchword and is not transcribed as one; it may be a printed mark of the sheet.
